items.title: Battery State-of-Charge Device
items.description: Configuration for one battery state-of-charge calculation.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: Unique identifier used in MQTT topics and Home Assistant device IDs.

name.title: Display name
name.description: Human-readable name for the battery state-of-charge device.

via_device.title: Parent device
via_device.description: Home Assistant device identifier that provides the battery telemetry.

charger_power_topic.title: Charger power topic
charger_power_topic.description: MQTT topic that reports charger power.

charger_power_json_key.title: Charger power JSON key
charger_power_json_key.description: JSON property containing charger power in the charger message. Leave empty when the topic carries a bare number, as the Trucki sticks publish it; a Shelly reports an object and needs its key here, for example apower.

inverter_power_topic.title: Inverter power topic
inverter_power_topic.description: MQTT topic that reports inverter power.

inverter_power_json_key.title: Inverter power JSON key
inverter_power_json_key.description: JSON property containing inverter power in the inverter message. Leave empty when the topic carries a bare number, as the Trucki sticks publish it; a Shelly reports an object and needs its key here, for example apower.

charger_dc_power_topic.title: Charger DC power topic
charger_dc_power_topic.description: Optional MQTT topic that reports charger power measured on the DC bus, for example DCPOWER from a Trucki T2MG. When set and fresh it replaces the AC charger measurement and no converter efficiency is applied.

charger_dc_power_json_key.title: Charger DC power JSON key
charger_dc_power_json_key.description: JSON property containing DC charger power. Leave empty when the topic carries a bare number.

inverter_dc_power_topic.title: Inverter DC power topic
inverter_dc_power_topic.description: Optional MQTT topic that reports inverter power drawn from the DC bus. When set and fresh it replaces the AC inverter measurement and no converter efficiency is applied.

inverter_dc_power_json_key.title: Inverter DC power JSON key
inverter_dc_power_json_key.description: JSON property containing DC inverter power. Leave empty when the topic carries a bare number.

dc_max_age_s.title: DC measurement maximum age
dc_max_age_s.description: Seconds a DC power reading stays valid. Once it is older the corresponding AC measurement takes over again.

bank_a_voltage_topic.title: Bank A voltage topic
bank_a_voltage_topic.description: MQTT topic that reports battery bank A voltage.

bank_a_voltage_json_key.title: Bank A voltage JSON key
bank_a_voltage_json_key.description: JSON property containing battery bank A voltage.

bank_a_voltage_scale.title: Bank A voltage scale
bank_a_voltage_scale.description: Multiplier applied to the reported bank A voltage.

bank_b_voltage_topic.title: Bank B voltage topic
bank_b_voltage_topic.description: MQTT topic that reports battery bank B voltage.

bank_b_voltage_json_key.title: Bank B voltage JSON key
bank_b_voltage_json_key.description: JSON property containing battery bank B voltage.

bank_b_voltage_scale.title: Bank B voltage scale
bank_b_voltage_scale.description: Multiplier applied to the reported bank B voltage.

bank_a_cell_count.title: Bank A cell count
bank_a_cell_count.description: Number of cells connected in series in battery bank A.

bank_a_capacity_ah.title: Bank A capacity
bank_a_capacity_ah.description: Nominal capacity of battery bank A in ampere-hours.

bank_b_cell_count.title: Bank B cell count
bank_b_cell_count.description: Number of cells connected in series in battery bank B.

bank_b_capacity_ah.title: Bank B capacity
bank_b_capacity_ah.description: Nominal capacity of battery bank B in ampere-hours.

topology.title: Bank topology
topology.description: How the two banks are wired. 'parallel' means both banks sit on the same DC bus and form one battery with a single bus voltage; a second voltage measurement is rejected because Kirchhoff forces both terminal voltages equal. 'series' means the banks are stacked, carry the same current and each needs its own voltage measurement.

charger_ac_dc_efficiency.title: Charger AC/DC efficiency
charger_ac_dc_efficiency.description: Fraction of the charger's measured mains power that arrives on the DC bus. MeanWell chargers are typically 0.88 to 0.92.

inverter_dc_ac_efficiency.title: Inverter DC/AC efficiency
inverter_dc_ac_efficiency.description: Fraction of the DC bus power drawn by the inverter that reappears as measured mains power. Lumentree inverters are typically 0.90 to 0.93.

charge_efficiency.title: Charge efficiency
charge_efficiency.description: Fraction of charging energy retained by the battery.

battery_chemistry.title: Battery chemistry
battery_chemistry.description: Cell chemistry. Only LiFePO4 is supported today; the calibration thresholds and the simulation curve both assume its flat mid-range voltage curve.

soc_curve.title: State-of-charge curve
soc_curve.description: Shape of the open-circuit voltage curve. 'generic_lifepo4' is a textbook LiFePO4 shape without a manufacturer source - the right pick when no data sheet for the installed cells exists. 'dyness_ar2.5' reproduces table 2-1 of the Dyness AR2.5-24V manual exactly, but only together with the empty/full thresholds 2.70 and 3.50 V per cell. The curve only sets the shape; where it sits in absolute volts is decided by those two thresholds.

empty_v_per_cell.title: Empty voltage per cell
empty_v_per_cell.description: Open-circuit voltage per cell used as the empty-battery calibration point. Must be reachable in practice: if the inverter cuts off above this voltage the 0% calibration never fires and the coulomb counter drifts without an anchor. 2.70 V equals 21.6 V on an 8-cell pack, the 0% row of the Dyness AR2.5 table.

full_v_per_cell.title: Full voltage per cell
full_v_per_cell.description: Open-circuit voltage per cell used as the full-battery calibration point. 3.50 V equals 28.0 V on an 8-cell pack, the 100% row of the Dyness AR2.5 table. If the charger's constant-voltage setpoint stays below this, the calibration tolerance below is what still lets the 100% calibration fire.

calibration_tolerance_v_per_cell.title: Calibration tolerance at low current
calibration_tolerance_v_per_cell.description: How far the empty/full calibration thresholds may soften when little current flows, in volts per cell. At rest or during the charger's constant-voltage taper the measured voltage is practically the open-circuit voltage, so a reading that falls just short may still calibrate; at bulk current the load compensation is too uncertain and the full threshold is demanded. Scales linearly between 0.02C and 0.10C. Set to 0 for hard thresholds.

calibration_tolerance_empty_v_per_cell.title: Calibration tolerance, empty side
calibration_tolerance_empty_v_per_cell.description: Overrides the shared calibration tolerance for the 0% threshold only. Leave empty to use the shared value; 0 explicitly means no tolerance. Set this generously when the BMS or inverter cuts off well above the configured empty voltage - otherwise the bottom anchor never fires and the coulomb counter only ever gets corrected at the top.

calibration_tolerance_full_v_per_cell.title: Calibration tolerance, full side
calibration_tolerance_full_v_per_cell.description: Overrides the shared calibration tolerance for the 100% threshold only. Leave empty to use the shared value; 0 explicitly means no tolerance. Keep this tight whenever the charger can actually reach the full voltage - every millivolt of tolerance here is a chance to calibrate a pack that is not full.

full_taper_c_rate.title: Tail current for the full calibration (C-rate)
full_taper_c_rate.description: The pack only counts as full when it neither takes nor delivers more than this C-rate at full voltage. Leave empty to disable. This is the counterpart to the calibration tolerance: with surplus charging a small current means 'little sun', not 'battery full', so the tolerance alone is unsafe. Use the tail current from the cell data sheet - Dyness AR2.5 specifies 5 A per 100 Ah pack, which is 0.05 C.

internal_resistance_mohm_per_cell.title: Internal resistance per cell
internal_resistance_mohm_per_cell.description: Optional override for the load compensation, in milliohms per cell. Leave empty to use the built-in load-offset table (equivalent to roughly 1.2 milliohms). Measure it as (loaded voltage - rest voltage) / current / cell count.

bank_b_enabled.title: Bank B present
bank_b_enabled.description: Set to false for installations with only one battery bank. Bank B is then excluded from the current split, the combined state of charge and the imbalance warning.

imbalance_warn_v.title: Bank imbalance warning threshold
imbalance_warn_v.description: Absolute voltage difference between bank A and bank B in volts above which the imbalance warning turns on. 0.5 V is roughly 60 mV per cell on an 8-cell bank.

calibration_hold_s.title: Calibration hold time
calibration_hold_s.description: Seconds a voltage must remain stable before calibration is applied.

voltage_soc_mismatch_warn_pct.title: Voltage/coulomb mismatch threshold
voltage_soc_mismatch_warn_pct.description: Percentage points of deviation between the voltage-based SoC estimate and the coulomb-counted SoC above which the mismatch warning can turn on. Kept generous because the voltage estimate is very uncertain in the flat LiFePO4 mid-range.

voltage_mismatch_hold_s.title: Voltage/coulomb mismatch hold time
voltage_mismatch_hold_s.description: Seconds the deviation must stay above the threshold before the mismatch warning turns on.

state_file.title: State file
state_file.description: Path used to persist the calculated battery state.

stale_input_s.title: Stale input timeout
stale_input_s.description: Seconds after which an input without updates is considered stale.

require_fresh_inputs.title: Require fresh inputs
require_fresh_inputs.description: False (default): a stale input does not halt the calculation - stale power topics count as 0 W and stale voltage readings keep their last known value (the 0%/100% calibration always still requires a fresh voltage, regardless of this setting). True restores the strict legacy behaviour where coulomb counting pauses completely while any configured input is stale.

simulation_charger_power_w.title: Simulation charger power
simulation_charger_power_w.description: Charger power in watts used by simulation mode.

simulation_inverter_power_w.title: Simulation inverter power
simulation_inverter_power_w.description: Inverter power in watts used by simulation mode.
